blocks.text: Jandaron (organisms) ko apni baqa (survival) aur dekh-bhaal ke liye ghiza (nutrition) chahiye. Ghizai juz (nutrient) woh madda hai jo jism ko metabolism ke liye zaroori ajza faraham karta hai. Khaas nutrients jaise carbohydrates, lipids aur proteins tawanai (energy) ka zariya hain; doosre, jin mein pani, electrolytes, maadniyat (minerals) aur vitamins shamil hain, metabolism ke amal ke liye zaroori hain. Nutrition se murad woh tamam amal hain jo kisi jandar mein nashonuma (growth), marammat (repair) aur sargarmiyon ko qaim rakhne ke liye nutrients lene aur istemal karne mein shamil hain.

Tamam autotrophic jandaron ko carbon dioxide aur pani chahiye, jo carbon, oxygen aur hydrogen dete hain, yani namiyati (organic) molecules banane ke liye darkar bunyadi anasir (elements). Pode bohat se doosre nutrients mahol se lete hain, aur yeh do giroh mein batte hain. Macronutrients nisbatan zyada miqdar mein chahiye hote hain: yeh nau hain, yani carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, potassium, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium aur sulphur. Micronutrients bohat kam miqdar mein chahiye hote hain: yeh saat hain, yani iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine aur boron.

blocks.title: Khaad (fertilisers)
blocks.text: Khaad (fertilisers) mitti mein is liye dali jati hai ke faslon ko macronutrients aur micronutrients mil saken.

blocks.title: Manganese aur dabao (stress)
blocks.text: Manganese antioxidant enzymes jaise superoxide dismutase (SOD) ki sargarmi ke liye aham hai, jo na-mawafiq mahol mein podon par oxidative dabao (stress) kam karne mein madad karte hain.
Keere khane wale (insectivorous) podon mein ghiza

Kuch pode ghair-namiyati (inorganic) nutrients ke ilawa keeron aur nanhe janwaron ko pakar kar aur tor kar hasil kiye gaye organic molecules se apni ghiza mein izafa karte hain. Tamam insectivorous pode asal mein autotrophs hain, magar shikar pakarne par un ki nashonuma tez ho jati hai; janwar ke jism ke nitrogen wale compounds zahir hai faida dete hain. Pakre hue keere patton se nikle enzymes se tore jate hain. Pitcher plant, Venus fly trap aur sundew mashhoor insectivorous pode hain.

items: Pitcher plant: patte ek thaili ya surahi (pitcher) mein badal jate hain jo kuch had tak pani se bhari hoti hai. Patte ka sira ek dhakna (hood) banata hai jo munh ko kuch dhaanp leta hai, aur bohat se sakht baal chhote keeron ko gir jane ke baad bahar rengne se rokte hain.

blocks.alt: Patte ka phal jis ka sira mur kar ek bel (tendril) ki tarah hari surahi (pitcher) ban jata hai. Surahi ka kinara surkh hai aur munh ke upar dhakkan jaisa Hood hai; andar ki deewar par sakht baal neeche ki taraf hain; neeche ka hissa pani se bhara hai jis mein do keere phanse hain. Labels: Hood, Pitcher, Stiff hairs, Water, Trapped insect, Leaf.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Pitcher plant, keere patte ke andar phans jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer (photo) hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Patte ka sira surahi ban jata hai. Keera kinare par aata hai, neeche ki taraf jhuke sakht baal use wapas nikalne nahin dete, aur woh pani mein gir kar doob jata hai. Phir enzymes us ke jism ko hazam karte hain aur pauda nitrogen le leta hai.

items: Venus fly trap: har patte ke sire par do qabze-dar (hinged) lobes ka phanda hota hai. Andar ki satah par trichomes, baal jaise ubhaar, hote hain jo shikar chhoote hi lobes ko tezi se band kar dete hain. Qabze-dar phande ke kinaron ke bareek baal band hone par ek doosre mein phans jate hain taake shikar bhaag na sake; patte ki satah ke glands se nikle enzymes use hazam karte hain aur hasil shuda maddey jazb ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: khula hua jaal, paron wale danthal (leaf stalk) ke sire par do surkh phankein (lobes) jo darmiyani rag par qabze (hinge) se juri hain; kinaron par sakht bristles aur andar ki satah par chand peele trichomes. Daen: band jaal jis ke bristles aapas mein phanse hain aur andar keera qaid hai. Labels: Bristles, Trichomes, Lobe, Hinge, Leaf stalk, Trapped prey, Closed trap.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Venus fly trap, shikar patte ki do phankon (lobes) ke darmiyan phansta hai (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Phankon ki andar ki satah par trichomes hain. Keera inhen chhoota hai to phankein foran band ho jati hain aur kinare ke bristles salakhon ki tarah aapas mein phans kar keere ko bahar nahin nikalne dete.

items: Sundew: chamakdar shabnam (dew) ke qatron se shikar pakarta hai, jin se is ka naam para. Patte nanhe tentacle jaise balon se dhake hote hain, har ek ke sire par ek gland aur shabnam ka ek qatra. Pode ki boo se khinche keere tentacles mein phans jate hain, enzymes se hazam hote hain aur maddey jazb ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Danthal par gol hara patta jis ke gird bohat se surkh tentacle-numa baal hain, har ek ke sire par chamakti shabnam (dew drop); patte par chhote ghadood wale baal. Daen taraf tentacles ek keere par jhuk gaye hain jo un se chipka hai. Labels: Dew drop, Tentacles, Leaf, Trapped insect.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Sundew, keere tentacles mein ulajh jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Har tentacle ke sire ka qatra chipchipa hota hai. Chamak se aaya keera chipak jata hai, aas paas ke tentacles us par jhuk kar use lapet lete hain aur enzymes use hazam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek tamatar ke pode ke patton par gehre dhabbe hain, aur ek makai ke pode ke patton ki ragon ke darmiyan zardi hai. Har ek mein kis nutrient ki kami hai, aur woh macro- ya micronutrient hai?
blocks.explanation: Patton par gehre dhabbe potassium ki kami batate hain, jo pani ke intizam aur naqal mein shamil macronutrient hai. Ragon ke darmiyan zardi (interveinal chlorosis) iron ki kami batati hai, jo chlorophyll banane ke liye darkar micronutrient hai.

items: Nutrients tawanai dete hain (carbohydrates, lipids, proteins) ya metabolism ko sahara dete hain (pani, electrolytes, minerals, vitamins); nutrition un ka lena aur istemal hai.
Nau macronutrients: C, H, O, N, K, Ca, P, Mg, S. Saat micronutrients: Fe, Mn, Zn, Mo, Cu, Cl, B. Har ek ka kirdar aur kami ki nishani hai, nashonuma rukne se zardi tak.
Insectivorous pode (pitcher plant, Venus fly trap, sundew) autotrophs hain jo patton ke enzymes se keere pakar aur hazam kar ke nitrogen hasil karte hain.
